n67f8766103.headline: Experts proffer sustainable economic recovery solutions
n67f8766103.summary: The President of the Lagos Chamber of Commerce and Industry highlighted Nigeria's import dependence and urged the government to develop a roadmap for economic diversification.
n67f8766103.why: Diversification is essential for Nigeria to reduce vulnerability to oil price shocks and build sustainable growth.
